key_points: DuPont’s new EDI water-treatment modules target growing industrial and semiconductor purification demand.
Collaboration with Microsoft and NobleAI on AI-assisted R&D is a modest long-term productivity catalyst.
Semiconductor-related water demand provides a favorable niche growth angle.
Broader chemical-industry headwinds and weak end-market demand limit upside near term.
News is incremental rather than thesis-changing; impact is modest but supportive.
